decisions.statement: A row with no children is drawn as a leaf.
A row beneath the top row is drawn expanded while a filter narrows the tree and collapsed otherwise.
A filtered row takes an id of its own so the editor draws that row again.
A row with children is badged with the count of children that row has.
A row whose children carry colors counts those children by color after that.
A row whose children carry no color takes no count by color.
The last line of a tooltip is the page akasha has for the row.
A row akasha has no page for says so rather than leaving the line out.
A subagent's tooltip names the subagent, whether it was stopped, and its page.
A seat's row has the context value its menus are keyed on.
A subagent's row has a context value saying whether that subagent was stopped.
The top row has `root` as its context value.
The top row's tooltip is the top row's own name and nothing else.
The top row takes no decoration and opens nothing.
A click on a seat brings the terminal that seat is working in forward.
A click on a subagent opens the page akasha has for that subagent.
A subagent akasha has no page for answers no click.
A stopped seat or a subagent or a turn color takes its own decoration.
A stopped seat's row is drawn in the color that seat's turn state names.
A row naming no color takes a path with no color in it.
The word a decoration carries is its tooltip rather than its badge.
A tree under no filter counts no matches rather than counting every row.
Nothing here reads the fleet.

definition: how a row of the agent tree draws, what it opens, and the color a decoration gives it
